EX-99.1 2 ny20064909x3_ex99-1.htm EXHIBIT 99.1 Exhibit 99.1 News Release | | IREN Expands AI Cloud Capacity to 150,000 GPUs NEW YORK, March 4, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) - IREN Limited (NASDAQ: IREN) (“IREN”) today announced it has entered into purchase agreements for over 50,000 NVIDIA B300 GPUs that will expand its total fleet to 150,000 GPUs. Time-to-compute is an increasingly important factor in today’s AI cloud market.
